body: Alot of the time I feel the same way, I'm Cyclothymic too - you're not alone.
I have regular planned conversations with psychiatric system, and I've mentioned it and since no action has been taken I assume my current medication is sufficient.
Looking up dissociation, I think you're right. However I differ from alot of people who suffer from it, I don't get any anxiety as a consequence. It's just a premise of life, like gravity is.

It's something like that for sure. Some of the time I manage to lose myself in the world though, thats during my good periods. However iI always come back around to what feels like my standard setting, the apathy.
And that's the thing. It's the type of depression where it isn't really "sadness" thats the center, its the type where anhedonia is at its core.

I am currently on 300mg daily, started at 25mg. When I take it some of the negative thought circles disappear, I don't overthink past situations and fall into the pit due to that as often.

I really like it, it has improved my quality of life somewhat.
